users: researchers analyzing declared pool-boiling image data with compatible BubbleID models
supported_tasks: extract bubble statistics and interface features
not_intended_for: unvalidated transfer to a new optical setup, fluid, surface, geometry, or operating regime; use of weights without their separate terms; or a substitute for experiment-specific ground truth

limitations: Pretrained models were trained on manually labeled pool-boiling data and may require fine-tuning for new data.
Model weights and data are distributed separately and retain their own terms.
